preservation_rule: The original v1.3 specification and all v1.2 results remain unchanged and reportable.

population.labels: tier_1 computationally curated direct functional agonist versus antagonist

model.formula: agonist ~ chemistry_PC1 + chemistry_PC2 + chemistry_PC3 + m_pk + d_pk
model.continuous_standardization: z_score fitted on development and applied unchanged to holdout

confirmatory_endpoint.test: one-sided label permutation within the rebuilt locked holdout

mandatory_sensitivity.joint_model: add d_cnnscore to quantify pose-quality entanglement

predictive_sensitivity.models: reuse frozen v1.2 AB and E feature definitions and ridge-logistic settings
predictive_sensitivity.metric: ROC AUC and E minus AB

gate_separation.model_promotion: confirmatory endpoint and uncertainty rules in this specification

promotion_rule: A positive holdout result supports a conformation-associated CNN scoring signal, not biological efficacy; external or experimental validation remains required.
